prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic sports portrait using the uploaded approved adult face reference with strict facial identity preservation. Show a clearly adult female volleyball athlete in three-quarter side profile with a calm focused competitive expression, dark brown hair in a high ponytail with soft bangs and natural sports makeup. Her hands are raised mid-clap. She wears a yellow and navy sleeveless volleyball jersey, a black compression arm sleeve on the right arm and full-length black athletic pants made from sporty fitted opaque fabric; legs remain fully covered. Set the scene in an indoor sports arena with a blurred volleyball court, pink and white wall panels and teammates in soft background blur. Use bright even sports lighting, eye-level medium framing, shallow depth of field, sharp face and upper-body focus, natural skin texture and 8K photorealistic detail. Preserve the approved adult identity, jersey, sleeve, pants and no-outfit-change constraint.
